scope: Local ordinary existing-interest evidence mapping only. No verified share, work identity, authority, provider form, submission, acceptance or receipt. Preserve the original collection-share convention and account-specific unknowns.

existing work ID.next_step: Map the exact already registered work and observed version. Corroborate its identity before an ordinary claim; do not create a duplicate registration.

claimed interest.next_step: Map the documented interest being claimed, preserving its original share convention, represented party, territory and effective period. Do not invent shares, infer ownership totals or reduce another interest.
claimed interest.basis: The Claiming Tool handles available shares on existing works; scope and non-inference safeguards come from the local catalog contract.

authority.next_step: Map actual mandate/authority evidence for the represented interest and period. A Member role or login is not proof of entitlement; administered interests remain subject to the documented mandate.
authority.basis: Local catalog authority contract; not a provider form field.

before/after values.next_step: Preserve current and requested values as separate versioned evidence, retaining prior submissions and original disclosure. No current interest is changed by preparation.

existing_share_review.existing_work: Verify the exact existing work identity and observed version. Use the existing-record claim path rather than duplicate creation.
existing_share_review.interest_and_authority: Verify the claimed collection interest, source share convention, mandate, territory and dates. Do not infer entitlement from account access or force an ownership total.
existing_share_review.before_after: Review exact current and claimed values and original disclosure, preserving source versions and prior history. Do not invent consent or reduce others shares to satisfy a total.
existing_share_review.ordinary_claim_scope: Distinguish an ordinary existing-interest claim from a technical amendment, new registration or substantive competing claim. Preserve adverse facts for resolution; the helper does not classify evidence contents.
existing_share_review.accepted_claim: Preserve actual item history and any accepted collection claim on the exact work separately from submission, observed record and financial eligibility. A local packet has none of those outcomes.

review_basis: MLC instructions document existing-work claiming and registration history. Exact evidence, scope and authority review preserve local catalog safeguards; these are not provider form fields.
remaining_account_checks: Inspect current Member Hub claiming capability, work record, affected interests and mandate before any separately authorized claim.
Confirm actual provider fields and disclosure; complete local mappings do not establish filing readiness or authority.
